newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran security forces kill two Iraq-based rebels.
newsitem.headline: Iran security forces kill two Iraq-based rebels.

text.p: Security forces in southeastern Iran clashed with members of an Iraq-based armed opposition group, killing two, a newspaper said on Thursday.

The daily Ettelaat quoted the Intelligence (internal security) Ministry as saying its agents also seized arms, explosives and propaganda material after the shootout at a safe house of the Mujahideen Khalq group in Zahedan, a provincial capital near Iran's border with Pakistan and Afghanistan.
The Mujahideen on Wednesday reported the clash without mentioning any casulaties among its fighters.
Iran has said its troops killed more than 20 Mujahideen members, who it said had come from neighbouring Iraq to carry out sabotage, in several clashes in the past few weeks.

The Mujahideen have admitted that some of their forces, who they said belonged to underground cells in Iran, were killed. But the group said its fighters had slain or wounded "hundreds" of troops in a new campaign against the government.
Iran has not reported any casualties among its forces.
